name: crossfade
title: Crossfade
description: Swap content with a soft crossfade and no layout jump: tab panels, loaded states and changing values, with the leaving content made inert.
docs: Render the content for the current key as children and change activeKey when it changes; the previous content stays mounted just long enough to fade out. Old and new share one grid cell, so during the fade the box is as tall as the taller of the two. When the heights differ, wrap Crossfade in AutoHeight so the rest of the page glides to the new height instead of snapping once the fade ends. The leaving content is inert and hidden from assistive technology the moment it starts leaving. Pass moveFocus to move focus to the new content after a change. mode="wait" lets the old content leave before the new arrives. Reduced motion swaps instantly.
